Emma / team —

Quick replies inline and a couple of tactical proposals:

1) Canary cadence: we recommend 5% → 25% → 100% traffic split with 48-hour steady-state observation windows. If any of the three monitoring thresholds trip (latency p95 > 350ms, error-rate > 0.8%, or a quality regression on the smoke prompts) we automatically rollback to prior traffic distribution. That logic is encoded in the canary-checklist I attached.

2) Migration & rollback: planned approach is parallel write-forward migration + read-affinity toggle. Steps:
   - Stage artifacts (export v1) → dry-run in staging
   - Full export + incremental tailing for 48h (backfill window)
   - Cutover by switching read-affinity, then promote writes once sanity confirmed
Rollback path: flip read-affinity back and replay rejects from the tail; we keep a snapshot for 72h.

3) KV cache priming: if you have persistent prompt prefixes we will pre-warm KV caches during rehearsal to avoid cold-token latency spikes.

4) Rehearsal: propose Thu Mar 16 (internal) and Tue Mar 21 (with Onyx), so we run an internal sweep first.

Attaching: canary-checklist.xlsx (detailed run criteria + play-by-play).

-Jonas

Emma —

Thanks for the quick review. I uploaded an editable MAP (same structure as Marissa's PDF) to Google Docs and added explicit acceptance gates and ownership per milestone: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Onyx-MAP-Proposal

Acceptance gates (summary):
- Functional smoke: 95% of baseline tests pass (scripting in our eval harness)
- Performance: p95 latency < 350ms on production-like load + <0.8% error-rate
- Quality guardrails: candidate responses must not exceed the safety thresholds in our eval set; regressions trigger a rollback
- Operational readiness: on-call rotation and runbook approved, backup snapshot taken before each major step

Training plan:
- Admin cohort (Mar 22) — 2.5 hour workshop + admin playbook handoff
- End-user cohort (Apr 2) — 60 minute onboarding session + recorded playback

Proposed kickoff: Mon Mar 6 (internal dry run), Tue Mar 21 (customer rehearsal), Canary week Mar 20 (start traffic ramping Mar 22).
